description: The world's choice of backend, mask, profile, population seed, salt and lock.

backend.description: The person-generation backend, by id (`ARC-126`). Absent: the only backend the world's packs provide, or none.

lock.description: The lock, by name: `locks/<name>.yaml` of this World Pack.

mask.description: The mask applied to the backend's catalogue, by id. Absent: the backend's default.

profile.description: The population profile people are sampled from, by its `profile:` id among the world's and its required packs' `populations/` files. Absent: no sampling.

salt.description: Changes sampled values only; the world's own population is the one this salt gives.

seed.description: The population seed: world content, never the run's `--seed`. Required when `profile` is set.
